text: mmx-quota-tool 是面向 DSH Web 的 MiniMax Token Plan 用量挂件，在会话输入栏显示当前 MiniMax 模型的 5 小时用量百分比，并可展开查看各模型的 5 小时与周用量、重置倒计时和绝对用量。它由 host 定时读取 MiniMax 配额接口并向前端提供快照，界面按用量显示状态并支持手动刷新。适合需要在 DSH Web 中随时查看 MiniMax 额度的人。需要 MiniMax API 凭据；区域可选中国或全球接口。

mmx-quota-tool adds a MiniMax Token Plan widget to DSH Web. It shows five-hour usage beside the model selector and opens a panel with per-model weekly usage and reset times. The host polls MiniMax and the client refreshes snapshots. MiniMax API credentials are required.
想在 DSH Web 里直接看到 MiniMax 额度还剩多少。
能不能在模型选择器旁显示五小时用量？
我想查看 MiniMax 各模型的周用量和重置时间。
让 DSH 显示当前 MiniMax 模型的配额百分比。
用量数据没更新时，怎么手动刷新额度面板？
想知道哪些 MiniMax 模型快到五小时限额了。
Show my MiniMax quota beside the model selector in DSH Web.
How can I check weekly usage and reset times for each MiniMax model?
mmx-quota-tool 的功能「在输入栏查看五小时用量」：当前 MiniMax 模型匹配时，在会话输入栏显示 5 小时用量百分比，并用颜色提示用量区间；非 MiniMax 模型时隐藏挂件。
mmx-quota-tool 的功能「展开各模型配额详情」：点击用量挂件打开详情面板，列出返回的各模型 5 小时与周用量、额度数量和重置倒计时。
mmx-quota-tool 的功能「周期刷新用量数据」：host 按配置间隔轮询 MiniMax Token Plan 接口，浏览器端每 5 秒读取快照以更新挂件。
mmx-quota-tool 的功能「手动刷新配额」：在挂件上 Shift+点击会请求立即刷新；面板显示最近更新时间及刷新错误。
mmx-quota-tool 使用前须知：需要可用的 MiniMax API 凭据；插件将凭据作为 Bearer 与 x-api-key 请求头访问所选区域的 MiniMax Token Plan API。
mmx-quota-tool 使用前须知：host 使用本机 /usr/bin/curl 子进程请求 MiniMax 接口，需在 DSH Web 环境提供 subprocess 服务。

mmx-quota-tool README · mmx-quota-tool：MiniMax token-plan quota dock for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) web.

Shows a drop-shape icon + 5h **usage %** in the conversation input area (next to the model selector). Click for a detail panel listing every model's 5h & weekly usage, reset countdown, and absolute numbers. Auto-hides when the active default model is not a MiniMax model.

mmx-quota-tool README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:mtty-ai/mmx-quota-tool
```

Then restart `dsh web` once.

mmx-quota-tool README · Manual install (development)：```sh
git clone https://github.com/mtty-ai/mmx-quota-tool
cd mmx-quota-tool

mmx-quota-tool README · copy or link the package into your profile's node_modules：cp -R . ~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/mmx-quota-tool/
```

Then add the row to `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: mmx-quota-tool
      name: mmx-quota-tool
```

mmx-quota-tool README · Configuration：This plugin requires a MiniMax API key. Export it before launching `dsh web`:

```sh
export MMX_API_KEY='sk-cp-your-key-here'
dsh web
```

Or put it in your shell rc (`~/.zshrc`, `~/.bashrc`).

Optional environment variables:

mmx-quota-tool README · Configuration：| Var                   | Default                              | Purpose                                |
| --------------------- | ------------------------------------ | -------------------------------------- |
| `MMX_API_KEY`         | *(required)*                         | MiniMax Bearer + x-api-key             |
| `MMX_REGION`          | `cn`                                 | `cn` (api.minimaxi.com) or `global` (api.minimax.io) |
| `MMX_REFRESH_MS`      | `60000`                              | Host poll interval against upstream    |
| `MMX_POLL_INTERVAL_MS`| `5000`                               | *(client bundle)* Client fetch interval|

mmx-quota-tool README · Configuration：The client bundle polls the host every 5 s so model-switch visibility is
within 5 s; the actual upstream fetch runs every `MMX_REFRESH_MS`.

mmx-quota-tool README · Behavior：- The dock appears in the conversation input area (`conversation.input.left`),
  adjacent to the model selector.
- Icon is a drop/water shape, filled by 5h **usage** % (lower bar = better):
  - `< 50%` green
  - `< 80%` yellow
  - `≥ 80%` red
- Click toggles a detail panel; mouse-leave the dock or panel closes it.
- Shift+click forces an immediate upstream refresh.
- The dock is hidden entirely when the active default model is not a MiniMax
  model — matched providers `minimax / minimax-cn / minimax-global / MiniMax*`
  or model prefixes `MiniMax- / minimax-`.
- Model name labels follow the active DSH UI locale:
  - zh: 通用 / 视频 / 图像 / 音频 / 语音 / 音乐 / 视觉 / 向量 / 实时 / 长文本
  - en: General / Video / Image / Audio / Speech / Music / Vision / Embedding / Realtime / Long context
- The dock label, panel header / headline / footer hint all switch
  language when the user changes DSH's interface language.
- The default is `zh` (Chinese) — the language the upstream token-plan
  model names resolve to most naturally. If the locale service is
  unavailable the dock still renders.

mmx-quota-tool README · Architecture：| Half   | File                  | Responsibility                                       |
| ------ | --------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------- |
| Host   | `src/index.js`        | 60 s upstream poll + exposes two HTTP routes          |
| Client | `client/client.js`    | 5 s poll + mounts the dock UI in `conversation.input.left` |

The host registers two routes on the profile's `webServer`:

mmx-quota-tool README · Architecture：- `GET  /api/mmx-quota-tool/quota`    — current snapshot
- `POST /api/mmx-quota-tool/refresh`  — force refresh

Returns `{ rows, lastFetchedAt, lastError, lastStatus, model, isMmx,
refreshIntervalMs }`.

The client polls `quota` and renders `null` when `isMmx === false`, so
switching to a non-MiniMax model hides the dock within 5 s.
